title: SA module-protocol v4 golden vector
description: Shape shared by the vectors in golden-vectors/. Every vector is produced by generate-vectors.py from docs/SA-MODULE-PROTOCOL.md alone and is consumed by BOTH kernels: SmartAccount.Contracts.Tests/ProtocolFixtureTests.cs (custom) and tests/SmartAccount.Native.Tests/UT_SmartAccountFixtures.cs (native).

constantsRevision.description: Git blob sha of each shared constants file the vector was generated against.

input.description: Exact byte-level inputs: network, coreHash (hex), accountId (hex display form), keys, subkeys, operation fields.

expected.description: Expected byte-level outputs. Kernel-independent values (identity, canonical operation bytes, key table) sit at the top level; digests that mix in a kernel's core hash or chain magic are pinned per kernel.

custom.description: Values for kernel #39, including its own coreHash and network magic.

native.description: Values for kernel #40, including its own coreHash and network magic.
